text:
Elena (PM): Quick alignment thread. Sales pushed back: they want a firm "burst credit transfer" option in contracts so customers can move unused burst allowance to short-term partner projects. We need to decide if that is MVP or cut. Also need final rollout gating and a short list of what to drop if timeline slips.

Marco (Eng-Platform): Technically moving credits between tenants opens accounting and security surfaces. For MVP we can support intra-account transfer (same org) behind a feature-flag but not inter-account. Implementation: token-bucket ledger + a transfer API that requires org-admin scope and audit log. If we do this, put it in SHOULD, not MUST.

Keisha (Eng-SRE): Ops view: transfers complicate billing reconciliation and alerting. If we ship transfers for MVP we must add a transfer_audit stream and 30d retention, plus alerts for suspicious transfer rates. I vote cut from MVP. Keep it as a pilot-only feature flag.

Rowan (Customer Success): Sales says customers care a lot about transferring unused credits; it helps close deals. But pilots are fine with a pilot flag. If we make it pilot-only and require manual enablement, Sales can negotiate.

Vik (Legal): Contractly: transfer functionality needs an Addendum and clear liability statements. For MVP we can allow transfers only within an org and require explicit admin consent. I'll draft addendum language once we decide feature scope.

Elena (PM): OK seems consensus: pilot-only feature-flag for transfers. Next: what to cut if we miss the ship date? My proposed cut list: 1) prewarm micro-pools, 2) per-route quota edits in UI, 3) long-term telemetry retention beyond 30d, 4) inter-org credit transfers. Keep MUST: allocation API, token-bucket, fallback ladder (quantized -> smaller -> queue), headroom telemetry, and contract fallback blurb.

Marco (Eng-Platform): Agree. Also propose a simple SLO scoreboard we can show to sales: P50/P95 latency, fallback_rate, burst_absorb_rate. If any SLO breaks during canary we stop rollout.

Keisha (Eng-SRE): Add chaos gating: synthetic 5m and 10m bursts, and a preemption test. If fallback_rate > 2% or P95 increases by >30% during these tests, we rollback. Include automatic rollback policy in Console.

Rowan (Customer Success): UX notes: banner needs to show "fallback active" + estimated quality delta and an "escalate to CS" link. For pilot transfers we need an audit modal listing transfer history.

Elena (PM): Rollout staircase proposal: internal canary 0.5% -> pilot tenants 5% -> pilot expansion 25% -> GA. Gate between steps: 24h stable SLOs and no critical fallback incidents >15m. Also require legal fallback blurb signed-off before pilot expansion.

Marco (Eng-Platform): Minimal autoscale defaults to include in docs (example):
```\n{\n  "policy_name": "reserve_mvp",\n  "scale_up_pct": 0.8,\n  "scale_down_pct": 0.35,\n  "min_replicas": 2,\n  "max_multiplier": 3,\n  "burst_window_s": 300,\n  "queue_ms": 120,\n  "fallback_order": ["quantized","smaller","queue"]\n}\n```\nThis is conservative and maps well to commit-based max_replicas = commit_base * max_multiplier.

Keisha (Eng-SRE): Add to that: instrument fallback.reason in traces with values like model_quantized, model_smaller, queued. Ensure fallback.reason is searchable in tracing UI for pilots.

Rowan (Customer Success): For pilot contracts we'll offer: operational remediation + prioritized support for fallback incidents. No financial credits for GA; pilot-specific financial credits can be negotiated. Mention transfer feature is pilot-only.

Vik (Legal): I'll craft a fallback clause and a short pilot addendum for transfers. Will highlight opt-out requirements for sensitive routes.

Elena (PM): Prioritization summary: MUST = allocation API, token-bucket ledger, fallback chain, headroom metrics, fallback traces, legal fallback blurb. SHOULD = feature-flagged intra-org transfers, banner for pilots, canary rollout. MAYBE = prewarm, inter-org transfers, per-route UI. Gate to GA: all MUST done, 2 pilot signoffs, 48h stable pilot telemetry, legal addendum for any transfers enabled.

Marco (Eng-Platform): I'll open the PR with token-bucket + autoscale defaults + transfer API stub behind feature-flag by Thu.

Keisha (Eng-SRE): I'll add chaos tests + alerts and ensure tracing tags are implemented.

Rowan (Customer Success): I'll collect pilot A redlines and confirm if they accept pilot-only transfers.

infra-bot: Created ticket PROD-2122 "Reserved Pools: transfer pilot + MVP gate checklist" assigned to Elena/Marco/Keisha/Rowan/Vik. Due 1730080000.

Elena (PM): Quick react check: :thumbsup: if you accept the cut list and pilot-flag plan, :eyes: to discuss.

Marco (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:

Keisha (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup: but will push on logging costs for transfer audit stream.

Rowan (Customer Success): :thumbsup: pending pilot A acceptance.

Vik (Legal): :thumbsup: will share drafts by Fri.

Elena (PM): Great. Standup tomorrow 10:00 to confirm PR link and legal blurb.
